_meta.group: Психиатрические препараты — SSRIs (5) + SNRIs (3) + Atypical (3) + Mood stabilizers (3) + Antipsychotics (4) + Benzodiazepines (4)

why_complex: Полипатологии overlap (depression/anxiety/sleep/cognitive coexist с физическими conditions)
Strong energy signatures (SSRI cooling+drying, benzo cold+heavy, antipsychotics suppressive)
class_notes.membrane_considerations: Хроническая depression часто = M-D drift (особенно melancholic). Anxiety = CA-like sympathetic activation. Bipolar — phase swings между анаболическим (mania) и катаболическим (depression).
class_notes.phase_considerations: Major depression often = stuck PCL-A. Anxiety = chronic CA. PTSD = repeated CA triggers.

constitution_axis: Mirtazapine heavy+appetite — great в frail elderly, terrible в metabolic syndrome
Bupropion activating — great в atypical depression, dangerous в anxiety/eating disorders
Benzos cooling/sedating — short-term ok, chronic problematic
membrane_axis: Lithium complex — renal M-D drift, thyroid suppression
phase_axis: Stuck PCL-A (chronic depression): SSRIs, SNRIs, atypicals
Stuck PCL-B (chronic fibrotic depression): activating agents (bupropion)

critical_safety: Suicide risk: first 2-4 weeks antidepressant initiation = highest window
Hyponatremia: SSRIs/SNRIs esp. elderly — check Na 2-4 weeks
Metabolic syndrome: antipsychotics (olanzapine, quetiapine) — baseline + quarterly lipids/glucose/weight
QT prolongation: citalopram >40mg, escitalopram, antipsychotics — ECG in susceptible
Lithium: level + thyroid + renal + calcium q3-6mo
CYP2D6 inhibitors (fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion) — major DDI esp. tamoxifen, codeine

Switching: failed SSRI → SNRI vs class switch?
